22.4. Special Values
Columns: f_n(x) | f_n(-x) | f_n(1) | f_n(0) | f_0(x) | f_1(x)
22.4.1  P_n^{(\alpha,\beta)}(x) | (-1)^n P_n^{(\beta,\alpha)}(x) | \binom{n+\alpha}{2} | [no f_n(0) formula printed for this row] | 1 | \tfrac12[\alpha-\beta+(\alpha+\beta+2)x]

FIGURE 22.5. Gegenbauer (Ultraspherical) Polynomials C_n^{(alpha)}(x), alpha=.2(.2)1, n=5.
22.5. Interrelations
Interrelations Between Orthogonal Polynomials of the Same Family
Jacobi Polynomials
22.5.1  P_n^{(\alpha,\beta)}(x)=\dfrac{\Gamma(2n+\alpha+\beta+1)}{n!\Gamma(n+\alpha+\beta+1)}G_n\Big(\alpha+\beta+1,\beta+1,\dfrac{x+1}{2}\Big)
22.5.2  G_n(p,q,x)=\dfrac{n!\Gamma(n+p)}{\Gamma(2n+p)}P_n^{(p-q,q-1)}(2x-1)\qquad\text{(see [22.21]).}
22.5.3  F_n(p,q,x)=(-1)^n n!\,\dfrac{\Gamma(q)}{\Gamma(q+n)}P_n^{(p-q,q-1)}(2x-1)\qquad\text{(see [22.13]).}
Ultraspherical Polynomials
22.5.4  C_n^{(0)}(x)=\lim_{\alpha\to0}\dfrac1\alpha C_n^{(\alpha)}(x)
Chebyshev Polynomials
22.5.5  T_n(x)=\tfrac12 C_n(2x)=T_n^*\Big(\dfrac{1+x}{2}\Big)
22.5.6  T_n(x)=U_n(x)-xU_{n-1}(x)

Also note 22.4.1 and 22.4.7 (Jacobi and Laguerre rows) print no f_n(0) closed form / have blank f_n(-x) and f_n(1) cells respectively -- confirmed blank in the scan, not an extraction gap.
